answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the lantern of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, forfeited on duplicate submission, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. A timber of per-task receipts records who did what, and the saffron of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
